upgrade_radius.title: Radius knob installed
upgrade_radius.hint: Hold Shift and turn the knob to resize the time bubble.

upgrade_shape.title: Shape cursor installed
upgrade_shape.hint: Hold Shift and drag the cursor on the oscilloscope to stretch the time bubble.

upgrade_time_shifter.title: Time Shifter repaired
upgrade_time_shifter.hint: Hold Shift to open it. Turn the wheel down to slow down time in the bubble.

upgrade_fast.title: Fast mode installed
upgrade_fast.hint: Hold Shift and turn the wheel up to speed up time in the bubble.
